mentions.name: Funny Fence Farm
mentions.description: An intentional farm-to-table co-housing network with properties spanning South Florida, Atlanta, and Cape Breton, Nova Scotia. Each property is tailored to reduce hospital readmissions, provide housing opportunities for high-risk groups, and offer lasting agrarian experiences. Members can access the other properties and their resources via provided transportation.
mentions.problem: Hospital readmissions and a lack of housing opportunities for high-risk groups.
mentions.audience: Various high-risk groups in need of housing opportunities
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been working on a intentional farm to table co-housing network spanning from S.Flo, ATL ,to Cape Breton in NS CAN. It's been a humbling experience of meeting, learning and living with great interesting people to say the least. Each property is different but all are tailored to reduce hospitals readmission, provide various high risk groups housing opportunities, and supply fun lasting agrarian experiences. Each member has access, via provided transportation to the other properties and it's different resources.
